title: Laptop answer-QR scan actually starts
reason: Discovered during 2b.5 real-device QA: with the phone finally loading from the public deployment, the user reached step 2 (laptop webcam scanning the phone's answer QR) for the first time and it silently did nothing — the camera turned on but no scanning started, so the handshake timed out to Error. Root cause is a latent 2b.2 bug: handleStartScan read videoRef.current while the <video> was unmounted (still 'showing-offer'), early-returning before setting 'scanning-answer'/starting the jsQR loop.
predecessor: phase-2b.5 (static-host QR pairing) — committed in 76eba81; this is the immediate follow-on that makes the now-reachable step 2 functional.
numbering: Appended as 2b.6 under the Phase 2b phone-as-sensor decomposition. No already-approved phase renumbered.
planning_gate: Not separately re-invoked — this is a localized bug fix within the pairing UI surface already analysed in the 2b.5 planning round. Recorded in decision-memo.md §'Phase 2b.6'.
scope_note: Fix = start scanning correctly (qrState-keyed effect) + higher capture resolution (1280x720) for dense-QR decode + live scan feedback. Real webcam decode→connected remains a §B2 manual gate; the reverse-QR path is inherently finicky and the manual-paste fallback remains the reliable escape hatch.
